items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 5 at 4:22AM PST until November 10 at 12:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding expected.
Dangerous rip currents and elevated surf expected along west-
facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Friday to noon PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest tides will occur in the late
morning each day, peaking at 7.4-7.6 feet Sunday and Monday,
which is 1.3 to 1.6 feet above astronomical tide predictions.
Surf will increase Monday.
items.instruction:
Coastal residents and managers of infrastructure in the advisory
area should prepare for rising water and take appropriate action
to protect life and property.

If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
